posters.title: Where do the world's whales live?
posters.subtitle: 1,407,365 individual OBIS occurrence records plotted · 9 whale groups · one dot per record
posters.blurb: Poster image of 1,407,365 OBIS records. Not a clickable map.
posters.badge: Poster image · not an interactive map
caveats: These are records, not individual animals or population estimates. The same animal can be recorded repeatedly. Survey effort affects the pattern, and blank ocean does not mean no whales.
Records with identical coordinates overlap, so every record is plotted but not every dot is separately visible. No sampling, gridding, smoothing or coordinate jitter was used.
This covers nine groups — humpback, blue, fin, minke (common and Antarctic), sperm, gray, right whales (Eubalaena), bowhead and orca — not every whale species.

sources.label: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) occurrence API. Each group's downloaded count matched the API total on November 8, 2026. Contributing datasets keep their own CC-BY or CC0 licenses; those licenses were not audited one by one.
